title: Big meteor over Åland the day after the June trip

tellings.quote: So, it was on the news that the big meteor over Åland and over here.

plain: In June 2025, the day after a search trip, a big meteor was seen over Åland, a group of islands in the Baltic Sea, and over the waters nearby. The treasure hunter Dennis Asberg mentions it, saying "it was on the news," so he is passing on news reports, not his own sighting. He brings it up because it came right after his team's trip to look at a strange object on the seafloor.
